phase_a_orientation.summary: NotificationScheduler.runOnce(limit) synchronously fetches repository.findPendingBatch(limit), then for each returned task marks it SENT via markSent(id) before dispatching sender.send(id), incrementing and returning the processed count after each successful send. The repository exposes only batch lookup and markSent; there is no claim/PROCESSING transition despite PROCESSING existing in NotificationTask.Status, so dispatch currently relies on the initial pending snapshot and persists SENT before the external send. An exception would stop the loop and may leave a task marked sent even though dispatch failed.
